attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: role-based-menu-rendering

steps:
  - id: read_session_role
    op: session/read
    params:
      fields:
        - user_id
        - role
        - is_admin
    output: session_data

  - id: fetch_role_details
    op: database/query
    params:
      table: roles
      filter:
        role_name: "{{ session_data.role }}"
      fields:
        - role_name
        - permissions
        - menu_sections
        - tier
    output: role_details

  - id: apply_role_routing
    op: rule/branch
    params:
      conditions:
        - when: "{{ session_data.is_admin == true and role_details.tier == 'admin' }}"
          result:
            tier: admin
            sections:
              - dashboard
              - users
              - settings
              - reports
              - audit_logs
              - admin_tools
              - content_management
            access_level: full_access
        - when: "{{ role_details.tier == 'manageAdmin' }}"
          result:
            tier: manageAdmin
            sections:
              - dashboard
              - users
              - settings
              - admin_tools
            access_level: admin_tools
        - when: "{{ role_details.tier == 'readOnly' }}"
          result:
            tier: readOnly
            sections:
              - dashboard
              - reports
              - content_management
            access_level: view_only
      default:
        tier: readOnly
        sections:
          - dashboard
        access_level: view_only
    output: menu_routing

  - id: format_navigation_menu
    op: transform/format
    params:
      template: navigation_menu
      data:
        user_id: "{{ session_data.user_id }}"
        role: "{{ session_data.role }}"
        tier: "{{ menu_routing.tier }}"
        access_level: "{{ menu_routing.access_level }}"
        sections: "{{ menu_routing.sections }}"
        permissions: "{{ role_details.permissions }}"
      options:
        mark_readonly: "{{ menu_routing.access_level == 'view_only' }}"
        disable_edit_controls: "{{ menu_routing.access_level == 'view_only' }}"
    output: navigation_menu
